text:
Aisha: Quick thought — Cyanis onboarding next week looks tight. Can we run a 'microburst' series (3 x 25m morning sessions) instead of a single 90m workshop? Poll below.
Priya: love that, reduces timezone overlap and attention fatigue. :thumbsup:
Marco: agree. Which days/timezones are you thinking?
Aisha: propose Mon/Wed/Fri 09:30 PT / 17:30 CET — hits NA morning + EU late afternoon. keeps each session focused.
Kei: can we get a facilitator rota? I'm only available Wed.
Samir: I can host Mon & Fri. @Kei can you take Wed hands-on?
Kei: yes, happy to run Wed deep-dive on runtime config + sample prompts.
Aisha: i'll draft a 1-page playbook and a 3-bullet success checklist. short pre-reads only.
Priya: i'll create RSVP + feedback form and an optional prep checklist. sending draft link in a sec.
Priya: https://forms.redwood/cyanis-microburst (placeholder) — fields: name, role, current model, top-2 blockers.
Priya: Proposed agenda snippet:
```
Agenda (25m)
1) 10m: goals + quick architecture overview
2) 10m: hands-on setup + 2 sample prompts (run time)
3) 5m: Qs, next steps + renewal touchpoint
```
Marco: pls add a quick 'renewal touchpoint' slide for session 1 — account health flagged medium-high risk. keep it factual.
Aisha: noted. i'll add a 2-slide renewal checklist (usage milestones, blocker remediation items).
Samir: ops-bot, can you create calendar blocks and send invites to Cyanis contacts + facilitators?
ops-bot: Created events: Mon 2025-06-02 09:30 PT, Wed 2025-06-04 09:30 PT, Fri 2025-06-06 09:30 PT. Calendar invites sent to Cyanis+facilitators. Reminder: invites include Zoom link + prep form.
Kei: ETA on the playbook/materials?
Aisha: i'll push a draft playbook to the shared drive by tomorrow 10:00 PT.
Priya: i'll schedule reminder emails at 48h and 24h. will attach feedback form and 1-slide checklist to invites.
Marco: can someone record Wed session? i'll be traveling.
Kei: i'll record and upload the video + timestamped notes to GH pages.
Samir: post-session ask: capture attendance, top-3 blocked prompts, and a prompt-quality score (1-5).
Aisha: perfect — i'll add those fields to the feedback form. thanks team :pray:
Priya: quick logistics q — facilitator pool for overflow? i can float if more than 20 devs sign up.
Samir: noted, i'll keep an extra invite slot and a standby facilitator.
Aisha: cool. final checklist before invites go live: playbook link, RSVP form, calendar invites created, recording plan, renewal slide. all in agreement?
Marco: yes. :+1:
Kei: yes.
Priya: yes — i'll flip invites live after Aisha's draft.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: invite follow-ups at 48h/24h pre-session.
Aisha: thanks all — will post the playbook link here when done.
